stem: A person waters a grapefruit tree on a sunny day. Which process MUST occur for the tree to use the water?

options.label: A
options.text: Water is absorbed by the roots and then moved to the top of the tree by the xylem.

options.label: B
options.text: Water is gathered by the leaves and then converted into glucose for the tree to use as energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Water is moved from the top of the tree and then transported into the roots by the phloem.

options.label: D
options.text: Water is collected in the flowers on the tree and then converted into tissue to produce bark.
